Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: A short, honest policy about the little data this site handles.
Privacy.collectText: When you use the contact form, we receive the name, email address and message you provide.
Privacy.useText: That information is emailed directly to the Kooked team so we can reply to you. It isn't stored in a database and isn't shared with anyone else.
Privacy.cookiesText: We only set one cookie, to remember your language preference (French or English). We don't use analytics or tracking cookies.
Privacy.rightsText: You can ask us to access, correct or delete any data you've sent us
